On quotation S00022 in the Sales app (customer 'fwod55-n2 Bench Customer') I clicked the Confirm button. The page then re-rendered as a confirmed order: the statusbar's checked state moved from "Quotation" to "Sales Order" (verified on the live DOM — .o_statusbar_status button[aria-checked="true"] reads "Sales Order"; the other two states, "Quotation Sent" and "Quotation", are now disabled), the breadcrumb shows "Quotations / S00022", and post-confirmation action buttons "Create Invoice", "Send by Email", "Preview" and "Cancel" are present. So (a) the order reference/name shown is S00022, and (b) the status the app now shows is "Sales Order".

Opened confirmed Sales Order S00022 (customer 'fwod55-n2 Bench Customer', Benchville) in the Sales app and cancelled it. The Cancel button opened the "Cancel Sales Order" confirmation dialog ("Are you sure you want to cancel this order?", buttons: "Send and cancel" = action_send_mail_and_cancel, "Cancel" = action_cancel, "Discard"). A stray "Edit: fwod55-n2 Bench Customer" contact dialog was stacked on top of the wizard (left over from the interrupted skill replay) and was blocking the wizard's buttons, so I dismissed it with Discard and then clicked the wizard's "Cancel" (action_cancel). The record now shows status "Cancelled": the statusbar's checked state is "Cancelled" (Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation all disabled) and a "Set to Quotation" button has appeared; breadcrumb reads "Quotations / S00022". Note: the replayed procedure s_3633eb stopped after step 2, so I finished the cancel by hand.
